stories.headline: Movies To Watch Before ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ - Forbes
stories.summary: Grab the popcorn and settle in, because here, in chronological MCU order, are both the specific and optional movies that will give you the bare minimum you need to know.
stories.why: You need the roadmap before dropping $15 on another MCU film—this tells you which prequels actually matter vs. which you can skip without feeling lost.

stories.headline: Ray J Says He Will Keep Boxing After Knockout, Hospital Stay - TMZ
stories.summary: Ray J says a knockout and four nights in the hospital still weren't enough to retire Reckless Ray ... 'cause he's got more crazy stuff to do before he finally grows up.
stories.why: Ray J represents the Peter Pan trap many men in this age group face: knowing you should grow up while convincing yourself that recklessness is still somehow aspirational.

stories.headline: Modest Mouse boots guitarist Simon O’Connor from tour after allegations he sent inappropriate messages to teen fan - Page Six
stories.summary: The user said they were 16 at the time of the interaction and had their date of birth listed in their Instagram bio.
stories.why: This is the cultural reckoning moment—when a beloved '90s alt-rock band has to answer for a member grooming a minor, forcing fans to reckon with separating art from artist.

stories.headline: Why Prince George's latest family outing with William and Kate meant more than it seemed - HOLA
stories.summary: William and Kate brought George, Charlotte and Louis to the Commonwealth Games in one of the family's last public outings before George begins Eton.
stories.why: George turning 12 and heading to Eton signals a generational shift in the British monarchy's public image, moving from cute kid content to serious institutional succession.

stories.headline: Sandra Bullock and Nicole Kidman Make Surprise Appearance at ‘Practical Magic’ Screening - The Hollywood Reporter
stories.summary: Ahead of 'Practical Magic 2' hitting theaters in September, the two stars brought some witchcraft to a Cinespia screening of the 1998 original on Saturday.
stories.why: Two Gen-X icons reuniting for a 'Practical Magic' sequel tap into nostalgic female power fantasy that's become a legitimate box-office demographic—and you're being reminded it exists.

stories.headline: ‘Lioness’ returns for Season 3—Here’s how to watch new episodes for free - Page Six
stories.why: Taylor Sheridan's Lioness Season 3 is premium TV validation for the guy who watches prestige drama; it signals his taste for character-driven spy thrillers is now mainstream enough for free streaming pushes.

stories.headline: Oba Femi's Win vs. Brock Lesnar at SummerSlam Marks the Start of WWE's Next Era - Bleacher Report
stories.summary: Few things in pro wrestling are bigger than a promotion's top title.
stories.why: A new wrestler dethroning Lesnar signals WWE's deliberate break from the Cena/Lesnar era—if you've checked out of wrestling, this is the moment to see if the product has actually evolved.
